div.div:
Notation (Crow's Foot)
PK primary key FK foreign key UK unique
underlined = primary-key column
NULL = nullable column (blank = NOT NULL)
type → table = FK whose line is not drawn here
Dashed table = reference stub (detailed on another page)
Line ends
┤├ exactly one o┤ zero or one
o< zero or many ┤< one or many
Composite / multi-column UNIQUE constraints, CHECK
constraints and append-only triggers are listed in
docs/database/DATABASE_DESIGN.md.

div.div:
Notes
• payments targets exactly one of order_id / purchase_id (CHECK num_nonnulls = 1).
• payments.reversed_payment_id: 1:1 self-reference; a payment can be reversed once.
• payments is append-only; corrections are REVERSAL rows.
• customer_id NULL = walk-in customer; customer_* columns are billing snapshots.
• UNIQUE (order_id, product_id), (order_id, line_no) on order_items; (sales_return_id, order_item_id) on sales_return_items.
